title: Estaba cocinando cuando sonó el teléfono
goal: a contar qué estabas haciendo cuando pasó algo, con el pasado continuo

ex.t: I was cooking when you called.
The phone rang in the middle of the film.
ex.es: Sonó el teléfono en mitad de la película.

vocab.note: Ring es irregular: ring → rang → rung.

ex.t: While I was shopping, it started to rain.
ex.es: Mientras hacía la compra, empezó a llover.
De repente, se fue la luz.

ex.t: There was a power cut last night.

vocab.es: un golpe en la puerta, alguien llama

ex.t: We were having lunch when there was a knock at the door.
ex.es: Estábamos comiendo cuando llamaron a la puerta.

ex.t: I fell asleep while I was watching TV.
ex.es: Me quedé dormida mientras veía la tele.

ex.t: At that moment, my son walked in.
ex.es: En ese momento entró mi hijo.

pron.title: was y were débiles
pron.tip: Dentro de la frase, was suena flojito, casi «uəz», y were casi «wə». Solo suenan fuertes al final: Yes, I was! Escucha: I was cooking → «aiuəz-cúkin».

exercises.q: I ___ cooking when the phone rang.
We ___ watching a film when the lights went out.
While I was shopping, I ___ an old friend.
exercises.why: La acción corta que interrumpe va en pasado simple: met.

exercises.q: She was ___ a shower when the doorbell rang.
exercises.es: Se estaba duchando cuando sonó el timbre.

exercises.q: They ___ in the park when it started to rain.
He ___ the newspaper. He was asleep!
You were working at nine o'clock.
answer: Were you working at nine o'clock?

exercises.q: We were watch TV when the lights went out.
exercises.why: El pasado continuo necesita la -ing: were watching.

exercises.q: My husband were sleeping when I came home.

exercises.es: Me quedé dormida mientras veía la tele
exercises.answer: I fell asleep while I was watching TV

exercises.context: Tu hijo te pregunta por qué no cogiste el teléfono. Estabas en la ducha.
options: Sorry, I was having a shower.
Sorry, I was have a shower.
exercises.answer: Sorry, I was having a shower.
exercises.why: Para explicar qué estabas haciendo en ese momento: was + -ing.
Fíjate en la -ing del final: cooking.

exercises.q: Estábamos comiendo cuando llamaron a la puerta.
answer: We were having lunch when someone knocked at the door.
We were eating when someone knocked at the door.
We were having lunch when there was a knock at the door.
We were eating when there was a knock at the door.
We were having lunch when somebody knocked at the door.
exercises.why: La acción larga en pasado continuo; la que interrumpe, en pasado simple.

exercises.t: I was cooking when the phone rang.
exercises.es: Estaba cocinando cuando sonó el teléfono.

dialog.title: La noche del apagón
dialog.setting: Yolanda le cuenta a Emma por teléfono lo que pasó anoche

lines.t: I called you last night, but you didn't answer.
lines.es: Te llamé anoche, pero no contestaste.

lines.t: Sorry! There was a power cut in the whole street.
lines.es: ¡Perdona! Hubo un apagón en toda la calle.

lines.t: Oh no! What were you doing?
I was cooking dinner, and my husband was watching the football.
lines.es: Estaba haciendo la cena, y mi marido estaba viendo el fútbol.
¿Y de repente se quedó todo a oscuras?

lines.t: Yes! While I was looking for candles, my phone died too.
lines.es: ¡Sí! Mientras buscaba velas, también se me apagó el móvil.

lines.t: What a night! Did you finish the dinner?
No. We had bread and cheese by candlelight!
lines.es: No. ¡Cenamos pan y queso a la luz de las velas!

questions.q: ¿Qué buscaba cuando se le apagó el móvil?

realLife.t: Sorry, I was driving. I'll call you back.
realLife.es: Perdona, estaba conduciendo. Te llamo luego.
realLife.context: Cuando ves una llamada perdida y devuelves la llamada

summary: Pasado continuo: was / were + -ing (I was cooking)
Acción larga (was cooking) + acción corta que interrumpe (the phone rang)
while = mientras: While I was shopping, I met a friend
Dentro de la frase, was y were suenan muy suaves
